blocks.title: For creators
blocks.body: Launch in one minute: name, ticker, image, done. A built-in bonding curve prices it from the first trade, so you don't need market makers or a presale. Your share vests over 180 days, so your community knows you won't dump on them.

blocks.title: For your community
blocks.body: 10% of every new token goes to that token's community pool. A share of every network fee goes there too. People who show up get a stake in what they build.

blocks.title: For everyone
blocks.body: All you need is a phone or a browser. No mining rigs and no big stake. Create a wallet in 30 seconds and try it on the testnet.

blocks.title: For builders
blocks.body: Describe a smart contract in plain words — we build it from audited OpenZeppelin templates.

footerCta.title: Testnet is open.
footerCta.body: Be early, break things, tell us what sucks.

notInvestmentDisclaimer: This is participation in a network, not an investment.

cards.title: Pay for real work
cards.body: Grants, subscriptions, and services — within caps the community sets.

cards.title: Rules you can vote on
cards.body: Caps, allow-lists, and freezes change only through token votes.

cards.title: Visible in the explorer

cards.title: Built for groups
cards.body: Clubs, creators, and local communities — not anonymous meme launches.
